privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.s1Body: We may collect account information, basic device information, language and region preferences, and app usage logs to provide and improve our service.
privacyPolicy.s2Body: Your data is used for account authentication, personalized content recommendation, feature quality improvements, and security risk control.
privacyPolicy.s3Body: We do not sell your personal data. Data is only shared with compliant service providers when necessary to operate core functionality.
privacyPolicy.s4Body: You can request to view, update, or delete your personal data. For any request, contact us through the in-app feedback page.

termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.s1Body: By accessing or using LifeStep, you agree to these terms and all applicable laws and regulations.
termsPage.s2Body: You are responsible for maintaining account security and all activities under your account. Do not share your credentials.
termsPage.s3Body: You agree not to abuse the service, interfere with normal operation, or publish illegal or harmful content.
termsPage.s4Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after updates means you accept the revised terms.

aboutAppPage.title: About us
aboutAppPage.s1Body: LifeStep helps Canadian immigrants stay informed about local life and practical information, while naturally improving their English through real-world reading.
aboutAppPage.s2Body: The current version supports flash news browsing, category exploration, push notifications, favorites management, multilingual interface switching, mood theme switching, and more.
aboutAppPage.s3Body: If you have suggestions or questions, please send us a message on the feedback page. We review every submission.
aboutAppPage.s4Body: All news content shown in the app is sourced from publicly available online content and is provided for reference only. If any content infringes your rights, please contact us for removal.
aboutAppPage.s5Body: If you would like to learn more about our products, services, and latest updates, please visit our official website

homePage.title: LifeStep - Practice Real-Life English
homePage.seoDescription: Interactive English conversations that prepare Canadian newcomers for real-life situations.
homePage.intro: Build confidence for everyday life in Canada through guided English conversations based on situations newcomers actually face.
homePage.footer: Real-life English for your new life in Canada.

features.title: Follow real life, step by step
features.body: A visual journey turns important newcomer moments into a clear path you can explore at your pace.

features.title: Know what to expect
features.body: Build context and vocabulary before a real conversation begins.

features.title: Listen, repeat, and respond
features.body: Hear natural voices and practise a complete dialogue or move through it one line at a time.

features.title: Make the language yours
features.body: Review key phrases, check your confidence, and complete each real-life scenario.

features.title: A path shaped around you
features.body: Choose study, work, or family and focus on the situations most useful to your life.

features.title: Keep your next step close
features.body: Optional notifications and a message center help you return to the right moment.

faq.question: Who is LifeStep for?
faq.answer: LifeStep is designed for newcomers preparing for everyday life, study, work, and family situations in Canada.

faq.question: Can I change the language and theme?
faq.answer: Yes. LifeStep supports ten interface languages plus light, dark, and system themes.

faq.question: How does conversation practice work?
faq.answer: Read the complete bilingual dialogue or practise one line at a time with natural synthesized voices.

faq.question: What situations can I practise?
faq.answer: Explore arrival, housing, transportation, healthcare, banking, education, work, and community scenarios.

faq.question: Can I continue where I left off?
faq.answer: Yes. LifeStep records your scenario progress so you can return to the next step.

faq.question: Can I use LifeStep on my phone?
faq.answer: Yes. The responsive web app works on desktop and mobile and can be added to your home screen.

sections: LifeStep helps Canadian newcomers prepare for real-life situations through interactive English conversations.
Follow a personalized journey through arrival, settlement, study, work, family, and community life, one practical scenario at a time.
Build context and vocabulary, listen to natural dialogue, practise line by line, and review useful phrases before using them in real life.
If you have a question or suggestion, send us a message through the feedback page. We review every submission.
